rubrics.justification: Description is broadly consistent with a 3AA blastocyst, but it overstates image-confirmable detail such as exact blastocoel proportion, cytoplasmic homogeneity, and precise positional features that may not be reliably visible from a single image.

Integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, diagnosis, semen parameters, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo quality, though some links (e.g., AMH implying oocyte quality/euploidy) are somewhat overstated.

Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with a plausible prognosis tied to morphology and patient factors; minor issues include confident euploidy inference from morphology and some optimistic quantitative claims.

Generally aligned on eSET and standard luteal support, but recommendations such as routine assisted hatching, ERA after limited failure, and relatively strong endorsement of PGT-A in a 34-year-old first-cycle unexplained case are not strongly guideline-supported.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including eSET and luteal support, though a few recommendations are more speculative than necessary.
